q: Which scope is electricity for my shop inside an airport terminal?
title: Airport shop electricity: which scope
short: If the airport bills you for your own metered electricity, report it as Scope 2. If power and cooling are built into the rent, it is still your use: get your share from the airport or estimate it by floor area, and label the estimate.
audience: Retail and food tenants at airports

ul: Own sub-meter billed by the airport: Scope 2.
Rent includes power: estimate your share, ideally reported as Scope 2.
Common area cooling: ask for the allocation method.

p: Request monthly kWh for your unit and the share of central chiller energy charged to it.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
